# Shared authentication

`loftet-auth-0.3.0.tgz` is the unmodified archive built by the sibling
`identity-component` repository. The pilot uses its encrypted AuthStore for
DID-bound browser sessions and server-side PDS credentials. Password sign-in is
restricted to operator-enrolled accounts on the isolated demo PDS. This is not
public-account OAuth or personnel-system identity assurance.
